messages:
Kendall (Finance): FYI - SummitEdge INV-2026-1999 is 61 days past due and ACH returned this AM. They emailed claiming ~18% of the invoice is disputed (test environment overage). Customer asking for a 90-day split and suspension of dunning on the disputed portion only.
BillingBot: Automated alert: ACH return (R01 - insufficient funds) for INV-2026-1999. Original due: 2026-03-01. Invoice total: $54,800. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1999
Priya (Account Exec): Spoke with their Head of Eng. They say an automated test suite accidentally sent high-volume inference during a migration window; they accept responsibility for non-disputed portion but want technical logs to justify the 18% they think was test traffic. Asking we not suspend onboarding.
Megan (Collections): Collections stance: we can entertain hold on the disputed dollar amount only if customer provides detailed evidence within 7 days, signs a dispute acknowledgment, and enables autopay for the undisputed balance. We do NOT pause dunning for the undisputed portion.
Omar (Finance Director): High level: Approve conditional partial-hold for documented disputes. Requirements: (1) evidence of test-run (request ID/logs) from customer; (2) PlatformOps verification of token counts; (3) signed dispute acknowledgement; (4) undisputed balance paid or guaranteed by card on file. If evidence proves system-side error, we can credit.
Legal Ops: I'll draft a short dispute acknowledgement + payment-plan addendum that allows us to place the disputed amount into temporary hold/escrow for 14 days pending verification. Add clause: if dispute not substantiated within 14 days, disputed amount becomes immediately due and dunning resumes.
Priya (Account Exec): Customer provided a sample log and a timeframe: 2026-03-08 02:00-03:30 UTC, request IDs included. I'll DM the file and schedule a joint verification call.
PlatformOps: Can confirm - we'll compare their request IDs against our ingestion logs. Expect results in <48 hours. Note: cross-check against rate limiter and infra autoscaling events.
Megan (Collections): Proposed commercial handling:
```
INV-2026-1999 total $54,800
Disputed amount: $9,864 (18%) -> place into temporary hold/escrow pending verification (14 days)
Undisputed balance: $44,936 -> require immediate payment or card on file + autopay
Customer requests: split undisputed balance into 2 installments (30 / 60 days) and pause dunning on disputed $9,864 only.
Collections conditions: signed addendum, card on file for undisputed portion, evidence submitted within 7 days, PlatformOps verification within 48h of submission.
```
Kendall (Finance): I can approve the temporary hold arrangement if conditions are met and Legal signs off on the escrow language. We need to track in AR as "partial-dispute" so automated dunning excludes the disputed line. Finance will require daily monitoring until resolved.
Omar (Finance Director): We should also require a payment method guarantee for the installment plan on the undisputed portion. If the undisputed part fails to pay, full service suspension and reinstatement of the entire invoice will occur.
Priya (Account Exec): Customer verbally agreed to provide logs and to put a card on file for the undisputed $44,936. They prefer 2 installments: $22,468 due on agreement, $22,468 due 2026-06-15. They want no suspension of onboarding while disputed portion is being verified.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare the two documents: (1) payment-plan + autopay consent for undisputed amount, (2) dispute acknowledgement + temporary hold terms. Will upload drafts to shared drive and link here.
PlatformOps: Verification complete (48h): their request IDs match high-volume calls flagged by our mitigation system; however, headers show the calls originated from a token tied to a customer test key. We recommend marking the 18% as suspected self-generated test traffic. Sending logs to Legal/Finance via secure link.
Megan (Collections): Given PlatformOps confirmation, Collections recommends: credit disputed $9,864 back to the customer as one-time adjustment contingent on signed dispute ack and continued autopay for undisputed installments. We still require card on file and first installment to clear before ledger change.
Kendall (Finance): Approve conditional credit after first installment clears and signed docs. We'll refund/credit the $9,864 and update AR. Finance to update aging and cash forecast post-clearance.
Omar (Finance Director): Approved. Collections: proceed with drafting the outbound containing the signed docs. Legal: finalize language for future dispute process so this case isn't precedent for automatic credits.
Priya (Account Exec): I'll collect the e-signatures and confirm card auth on the call at 10:30 PT. Will post signed addendum and payment receipt here.
Megan (Collections): Outbound ready pending signatures. Collections will flip internal flags: pause external dunning only for disputed $9,864 once first installment clears and signed docs are in.
BillingBot: Note: ACH retry recommended after authorization. Current external dunning resumed for undisputed balance.
Kendall (Finance): Thanks team. Please CC finance on outbound. Follow up here after payment clears and docs are signed. :white_check_mark:
